records.jp: 種族：エリスロ族^00コモン内のエーテルを運んで制御する、^00コモンにおける赤血球のような存在。^00力はそこまで強くない
records.en_original: Type: Erythro <CR>The red blood cells of the Common, they transport and maintain Ether. Fairly weak.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Erythro <CR>The red blood cells of the Common, they transport and maintain Ether. Fairly weak.
records.en: Type: Erythro^00They act like the Common's red blood cells,^00transporting and regulating Ether.^00They are not particularly strong.

records.jp: 種族：エリスロ族^00幸福の感情エネルギーから発生するエーテル^00を運んでいる。正の感情によるエネルギーを^00持つため、他の個体からは恐れられている
records.en_original: Type: Erythro <CR>These transport Ether derived from happiness. Feared by other specimens for holding positive emotional energy.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Erythro <CR>These transport Ether derived from happiness. Feared by other specimens for holding positive emotional energy.
records.en: Type: Erythro^00These transport Ether derived from happiness.^00Feared by other specimens for holding^00positive emotional energy.

records.jp: 種族：エリスロ族^00怒りの感情エネルギーから発生するエーテル^00を運んでいる。怒りの感情により、敵を威嚇^00するためのツノが生えてきた
records.en_original: Type: Erythro <CR>These transport Ether derived from anger. The rage they carry caused them to grow horns to intimidate foes.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Erythro <CR>These transport Ether derived from anger. The rage they carry caused them to grow horns to intimidate foes.
records.en: Type: Erythro^00These transport Ether derived from anger.^00The rage they carry caused them to grow^00horns to intimidate foes.

records.jp: 種族：エリスロ族^00あらゆる負の感情のエネルギーから発生する^00エーテルを運んでいる個体。他のエリスロ族^00より強い力を持っている
records.en_original: Type: Erythro <CR>These transport Ether derived from negativity. The strongest type of erythro.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Erythro <CR>These transport Ether derived from negativity. The strongest type of Erythro.
records.en: Type: Erythro^00These transport Ether^00derived from negativity.^00The strongest type of erythro.

records.jp: 種族：リューク族^00コモン内の敵や異物を排除している、白血球^00のような存在。元々コモンにいるはずのない^00リフレクターを排除対象と誤認している
records.en_original: Type: Leuk <CR>The white blood cells of the Common, Leuks remove threats as they see them. ...And they see Reflectors as threats.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Leuk <CR>The white blood cells of the Common, Leuks remove threats as they see them...and they see Reflectors as threats.
records.en: Type: Leuk The white^00blood cells of the Common,^00Leuks remove threats as they see them.^00...And they see Reflectors as threats.

records.jp: 種族：リューク族^00「コモン・リューク」たちを束ねるリーダー^00的な存在。浮かび上がる紋様は、力を保持し^00ている証で、この光が強いほど強い証
records.en_original: Type: Leuk <CR>A leader of the common leuks. Its emblem and radiance speak to both its military and physical power.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Leuk <CR>A leader of the Common Leuks. Its emblem and radiance speak to both its military and physical power.
records.en: Type: Leuk^00A leader that commands Common Leuks.^00The glowing pattern is proof of its power,^00and the brighter it shines, the stronger it is.

records.jp: 種族：リューク族^00「コモン・リューク」より上位に位置してい^00る個体。トゲの数が多いほど強い力を宿して^00いる
records.en_original: Type: Leuk <CR>More politically important than a common leuk. Their number of spikes are signifiers of their power.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Leuk <CR>Holds a higher position than a Common Leuk. Their number of spikes are signifiers of their power.
records.en: Type: Leuk^00A higher-ranking individual than a Common Leuk.^00The more spikes it has,^00the greater the power it holds.

records.jp: 種族：リューク族^00原種からの影響を受けすぎ、暴走している。^00圧倒的な戦闘力を誇るが、自分でも制御しき^00れず、自我は崩壊しているらしい
records.en_original: Type: Leuk <CR>Gone berserk due to sephira influence, these leuks are so powerful that their psyches are crumbling under the might.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Leuk <CR>Having gone berserk due to the influence of the Sephira, these Leuks are so powerful that their psyches are crumbling under their own might.
records.en: Type: Leuk^00Driven rampant by excessive Sephira influence.^00It boasts overwhelming combat power, but cannot control it,^00and its sense of self appears to have collapsed.

records.jp: 種族：マグマ族^00怒りのゾーンのマグマが原種の影響で魔物化^00した存在。人間の憤怒の感情によりできてお^00り、力が強いほど体温が高い
records.en_original: Type: Magma <CR>Born from magma, rage, and sephira influence, their heat is an indicator of their burning strength.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Magg <CR>Born from magma, rage, and the influence of the Sephira, their heat is an indicator of their burning strength.
records.en: Type: Magma^00Magma from the Anger Zone transformed into a monster by Sephira influence.^00It is formed from human rage,^00and stronger individuals have higher body temperatures.

records.jp: 種族：マグマ族^00「アノイアテイパー」の体温が極限まで上が^00りきったことにより誕生した変種。成分が違^00うマグマにより能力も変異している
records.en_original: Type: Magma <CR>A mutation caused by the anoia tapir's temperature reaching its limits. Their higher heat gives them new abilities.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Magg <CR>A mutation caused by the Anoia Tapir's temperature reaching its limits. Their higher heat gives them new abilities.
records.en: Type: Magma^00A variant born when an Anoia Tapir's body temperature reached its limit.^00Its magma has a different composition,^00causing its abilities to mutate as well.

records.jp: 種族：マグマ族^00「アノイアテイパー」がエーテルを得過ぎた^00結果、常にマグマが溢れ出続け、その怒りは^00全てを焦がす
records.en_original: Type: Magma <CR>Anoia tapirs that glut themselves on Ether and overflow with magma. Their wrath can reduce anything to ashes.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Magg <CR>Anoia Tapirs that glut themselves on Ether and overflow with magma. Their wrath can reduce anything to ashes.
records.en: Type: Magma^00Anoia tapirs that glut themselves on Ether^00and overflow with magma.^00Their wrath can reduce anything to ashes.

records.jp: 種族：マグマ族^00怒りの感情を吸い過ぎた結果、爆発する寸前^00の状態になっている個体。一見、燃え尽きて^00崩れそうだが、強いエネルギーを秘めている
records.en_original: Type: Magma <CR>Although they may seem burned out at a glance, these anger-devouring demons are nearly exploding with power.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Magg <CR>Although they may seem burned out at a glance, these anger-devouring monsters are nearly exploding with power.
records.en: Type: Magma^00An individual on the verge of exploding after absorbing too much anger.^00It looks burned out and ready to crumble,^00but still contains tremendous energy.

records.jp: 種族：彫像族^00驚愕の感情に付随するイメージが魔物として^00具現化した個体。その欠けた翼はイメージの^00共有ができていない名残りと考えられる
records.en_original: Type: Golem <CR>A manifestation of fright. Its shattered wings symbolizes an inability to empathize.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Golem <CR>A manifestation of fright. Its shattered wings symbolize an inability to empathize.
records.en: Type: Golem^00A monster formed from imagery tied to feelings of shock.^00Its missing wings are thought to be remnants^00of an image that was never fully shared.

records.jp: 種族：彫像族^00「デストラクトの彫像」とは違う素材で構成^00されている個体。その材質は光を反射して、^00より人に驚きや動揺を与える
records.en_original: Type: Golem <CR>Made of a more reflective material than Sculpture, Distract; it fills its beholder with a sense of unease.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Golem <CR>Made of a more reflective material than Sculpture, Distracts. It fills its beholder with a sense of unease.
records.en: Type: Golem^00Made of a different material than Sculpture, Distract.^00Its surface reflects light,^00making it even more startling and unsettling to people.

records.jp: 種族：彫像族^00驚愕の感情によるエーテルエネルギーを多く^00有している個体。その赤い体が示すのは一体^00何なのか、誰も知る者はいない
records.en_original: Type: Golem <CR>This specimen absorbed an extreme amount of fear Ether. As to what its crimson body signifies, no one knows.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Golem <CR>This specimen absorbed an extreme amount of fear Ether. As to what its crimson body signifies, no one knows.
records.en: Type: Golem^00An individual holding a great deal of Ether born from shock.^00No one knows^00what its red body is meant to signify.

records.jp: 種族：彫像族^00恐怖の感情ゾーンに完全に溶け込む色に変質^00した個体。急に現れるという、驚愕の性質が^00最も現れた姿であるといえる
records.en_original: Type: Golem <CR>A specimen with a color that blends completely into the Fear Zone. Appears from nowhere to scare its victims.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Golem <CR>A specimen with a color that blends completely into the Fear Zone. Appears from nowhere to scare its victims.
records.en: Type: Golem A specimen with a color^00that blends completely^00into the Fear Zone.^00Appears from nowhere to scare its victims.

records.jp: 種族：スカル族^00骨の周りに、液体で人間の形を形成した姿を^00持つ魔物。水たまりの中に隠れるなど、その^00性質は変幻自在
records.en_original: Type: Sepulchre <CR>A humanoid creature of water wrapped around bones. It's form is fully malleable, letting it hide in water.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Sepulchre <CR>A humanoid creature of water wrapped around bones. Its form is fully malleable, letting it hide in water.
records.en: Type: Sepulchre^00A monster with a human-shaped liquid body wrapped around bones.^00Its form is highly fluid,^00allowing it to hide in puddles and elsewhere.

records.jp: 種族：スカル族^00青い液体で体が覆われた個体。その青い色は^00憎しみの涙によるエネルギーでできており、^00力に耐えきれず、骨は錆色になっている
records.en_original: Type: Sepulchre <CR>A blue hued demon made of tears of sorrow. Unable to bear the emotional weight, the bones have become silver.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Sepulchre <CR>A blue-hued monster made of tears of sorrow. Unable to bear the emotional weight, its bones have become rusted.
records.en: Type: Sepulchre^00Its body is covered in blue liquid formed from the energy of hateful tears.^00Unable to withstand that power,^00its bones have turned rust-colored.

records.jp: 種族：スカル族^00「ボーダムスカル」から骨の構造が変質した^00個体。ぽっかりと開いた顔は流れ込んで来る^00負の感情への防衛本能に表情を消している
records.en_original: Type: Sepulchre <CR>A mutated boredom skull. It lost its face to protect itself from the constant cascade of negative energy.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Sepulchre <CR>A mutated Boredom Skull. It lost its face to protect itself from the constant cascade of negative energy.
records.en: Type: Sepulchre A mutated^00boredom skull.^00It lost its face to protect itself from the constant^00cascade of negative energy.

records.jp: 種族：スカル族^00全ての関心が無となり、自身の体についても^00関与しなくなった結果、体の液体が変質して^00異質な色を放つようになった存在
records.en_original: Type: Sepulchre <CR>An entity of complete ambivalence. Its liquid body allows it to glow and shift into strange shapes.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Sepulchre <CR>An entity of complete ambivalence. Its liquid body allows it to glow and shift into strange shapes.
records.en: Type: Sepulchre^00It lost all interest, even in its own body.^00As a result, the liquid making up its body changed^00and began emitting an unnatural color.

records.jp: 種族：天使族^00人間の過剰な喜びの感情がエーテルと混ざり^00あい、翼を得た個体。関節の部分にまとって^00いる光の球の輝きで個体の強さが判別できる
records.en_original: Type: Herald <CR>Born of Ether and humanity's joy, the light these demons emit from their joints displays their strength.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Herald <CR>Born of Ether and humanity's joy, the light these monsters emit from their joints displays their strength.
records.en: Type: Herald^00Born when excessive human joy mixed with Ether and gave it wings.^00The glow of the spheres around its joints^00reveals how powerful it is.

records.jp: 種族：天使族^00闇に染まった黒いパーツを持つ個体。^00「紫翼のティネレシー」と比較して暗い喜び^00がベースとなっており個体間での連携が苦手
records.en_original: Type: Herald <CR>Born of dark pleasure, these blackened heralds are too different from violetwing tineresies to cooperate.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Herald <CR>Born of dark pleasure, these blackened Heralds are too different from Violetwing Tineresies to cooperate.
records.en: Type: Herald^00Born of dark pleasure,^00these blackened heralds are too different from violetwing^00tineresies to cooperate.

records.jp: 種族：天使族^00強いエーテルをその身に宿して、体が美しく^00輝いている。群れのボスは目を開くのも困難^00になる程の輝きを放つ
records.en_original: Type: Herald <CR>Their shining, Ether-packed bodies can even blind their leaders when enough of them gather.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Herald <CR>Their shining, Ether-packed bodies can even blind their leaders when enough of them gather.
records.en: Type: Herald^00Its body shines beautifully with powerful Ether.^00The leader of a flock shines so intensely^00that it can be difficult even to keep one's eyes open.

records.jp: 種族：天使族^00全身が黒く染まった個体。本来のエネルギー^00源であった喜びではなく、それに付随してい^00るあらゆる負の感情を吸収して変異した
records.en_original: Type: Herald <CR>While heralds are typically beings of joy, this abyss-black mutation spawned from absorbing negativity.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Herald <CR>While Heralds are typically beings of joy, this abyss-black mutation spawned from absorbing negativity.
records.en: Type: Herald^00While heralds are typically beings of joy,^00this abyss-black mutation^00spawned from absorbing negativity.

records.jp: 種族：カカシ族^00無数の剣が刺さったカカシのような姿をして^00いる。どんな刃を受けても動き続けるその姿^00は人間の恐怖イメージが具現化されている
records.en_original: Type: Effigy <CR>Appears as a scarecrow, impaled by swords. That it still moves is the very image of human terror.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Effigy <CR>Appears as a scarecrow, impaled by swords. That it still moves is the very image of human terror.
records.en: Type: Effigy^00Appears as a scarecrow, impaled by swords.^00That it still moves is the very^00image of human terror.

records.jp: 種族：カカシ族^00恐怖の感情が由来のエーテルを吸収し過ぎた^00ことで体が黒く染まっている。闇に同化し、^00さらに恐怖させるが自分も不安になっている
records.en_original: Type: Effigy <CR>Blackened by fear, this demon sinks into the shadows to scare others... Though this makes it nervous as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Effigy <CR>Blackened by fear, this monsters sinks into the shadows to scare others...though this makes it nervous as well.
records.en: Type: Effigy^00Its body turned black after absorbing too much Ether born from fear.^00It blends into darkness to frighten others,^00but doing so leaves it anxious as well.

records.jp: 種族：カカシ族^00恐怖の悲鳴の感情が集まり具現化した個体。^00悲しみや不安、怒りといった感情も混ざり、^00よりヒビが強くなり壊れる寸前である
records.en_original: Type: Effigy <CR>Manifestation of a fearful scream. An amalgam of sorrow, unease, and anger, its own power may destroy it.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Effigy <CR>The manifestation of a fearful scream. An amalgam of sorrow, unease, and anger, its own power may destroy it.
records.en: Type: Effigy^00Manifestation of a fearful scream.^00An amalgam of sorrow, unease,^00and anger, its own power may destroy it.

records.jp: 種族：カカシ族^00中心のコアにエーテルエネルギーが全て凝縮^00しきった状態の魔物。一見弱々しいが、その^00力はかなりの強さを誇っている
records.en_original: Type: Effigy <CR>With great Ether energy in its core, its fragile appearance belies an unexpected, proud strength.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Effigy <CR>With great Ether energy in its core, its fragile appearance belies an unexpected, proud strength.
records.en: Type: Effigy^00All of its Ether energy is condensed into the central core.^00It looks frail at first glance,^00but possesses considerable power.

records.jp: 種族：機械族^00信頼や忠義心の感情エーテルが魔物となった^00個体。コモンだけでなく他の魔物もあらゆる^00外敵から守ろうとしている
records.en_original: Type: Automaton <CR>A demon born of loyality and trust. It tries to protect both the Common and its inhabitants from foreign enemies.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Automaton <CR>A monster born of loyalty and trust. It tries to protect both the Common and its inhabitants from foreign enemies.
records.en: Type: Automaton^00A monster born from emotional Ether of trust and loyalty.^00It tries to protect both the Common and other monsters^00from every outside threat.

records.jp: 種族：機械族^00より狂信的な感情が集まった個体。守る意識^00の強さからなのか、兵器を連想させるような^00攻撃を多く繰り出してくる
records.en_original: Type: Automaton <CR>A twisted amalgam of trust and over- defensiveness. <CR>It unleashes barrages of attacks with weaponlike <CR>strength.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Automaton <CR>A twisted amalgam of trust and over-defensiveness. <CR>It unleashes barrages of attacks with weapon-like <CR>strength.
records.en: Type: Automaton^00An individual formed from more fanatical emotions.^00Perhaps because of its powerful urge to protect,^00it unleashes many attacks reminiscent of weapons.

records.jp: 種族：機械族^00中心のコアにエーテルがたまり変異した上位^00の個体。コアも３つに増えたことで、さらに^00多くの力を集められるようになっている
records.en_original: Type: Automaton <CR>Mutated by a large amount of Ether energy, this demon is so strong, it requires three cores to operate.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Automaton <CR>Mutated by a large amount of Ether energy, this monster is so strong, it requires three cores to operate.
records.en: Type: Automaton^00A higher individual mutated by Ether accumulating in its central core.^00Its core count increased to three,^00allowing it to gather even more power.

records.jp: 種族：機械族^00喜びに付随するあらゆる感情のエーテルを^00吸収したことにより、複雑な回路を得た、^00強い個体
records.en_original: Type: Automaton <CR>Absorbing happiness Ether led to an automaton with more complex circuitry than average.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Automaton <CR>Absorbing Ether born of happiness led to an Automaton with more complex circuitry than average.
records.en: Type: Automaton^00A powerful individual that absorbed Ether^00from all emotions associated with joy,^00gaining complex circuitry as a result.

records.jp: 種族：結晶族^00悲しみの感情エネルギーにより魔物となった^00個体。そのツノは涙の結晶でできており、大^00きく濃い色である程強い個体であるとされる
records.en_original: Type: Crystal <CR>Formed from sorrow, the size and brightness of its horns signify its strength.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Crystal <CR>Formed from sorrow, the size and brightness of its horns signify its strength.
records.en: Type: Crystal^00A monster formed from the emotional energy of sorrow.^00Its horns are crystals of tears,^00and larger, darker horns are said to indicate greater strength.

records.jp: 種族：結晶族^00「クライホーン」と比較し、ツノの色が濃い^00個体。その黒さは悲しみの深さを表しており^00複雑なエーテルエネルギーを有している
records.en_original: Type: Crystal <CR>Deeper sorrow and more complex Ether energy have given this demon darker horns than regular cryhorns.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Crystal <CR>Deeper sorrow and more complex Ether energy have given this monster darker horns than regular Cryhorns.
records.en: Type: Crystal^00An individual with darker horns than a Cryhorn.^00Their darkness reflects the depth of its sorrow,^00and it holds complex Ether energy.

records.jp: 種族：結晶族^00頭部分だけでなく背中や尾など、あらゆる^00部分からツノが生えている個体で、より強い^00力を有している
records.en_original: Type: Crystal <CR>This specimen's strength is apparent in the horns bursting from its back and tail.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Crystal <CR>This specimen's strength is apparent in the horns bursting from its body.
records.en: Type: Crystal^00This specimen's strength^00is apparent in the horns bursting from its back^00and tail.

records.jp: 種族：結晶族^00体が神々しく、白い輝きを放っている個体。^00悲しみのエネルギーを完全に出しきった状態^00で純粋なエーテルエネルギーのみを宿す
records.en_original: Type: Crystal <CR>A specimen bathed in a divine white light. It has purged its sorrow energy embraced other types of Ether.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Crystal <CR>A specimen bathed in a divine white light. It has purged its sorrow energy and embraced pure Ether.
records.en: Type: Crystal^00An individual whose body gives off a divine white light.^00It has completely released its sorrowful energy^00and now holds only pure Ether energy.

records.jp: 種族：死神族^00警戒心が具現化した存在。非常に他の反応に^00対して敏感であり、常に相手の隙をうかがい^00攻撃をしてくる
records.en_original: Type: Reaper <CR>The manifestation of wariness. It is very senstive to how others react, and looks for any opportunity to strike.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Reaper <CR>The manifestation of wariness. It is very sensitive to how others react, and looks for any opportunity to strike.
records.en: Type: Reaper^00A manifestation of wariness, highly sensitive to others' reactions.^00It constantly watches for openings^00and strikes whenever it finds one.

records.jp: 種族：死神族^00身にまとうマントにもエネルギーをまとい、^00強い力を持っている。その赤いマントは保護^00色となり姿を隠すのに適している
records.en_original: Type: Reaper <CR>Its cloak is filled with energy, granting it great power. The red of the cloak acts as camouflage.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Reaper <CR>Its cloak is filled with energy, granting it great power. The red of the cloak acts as camouflage.
records.en: Type: Reaper^00Its cloak is filled with energy,^00granting it great power.^00The red of the cloak acts as camouflage.

records.jp: 種族：死神族^00マントがマグマと同化し、より強い力を得た^00個体。元々は相手を警戒する感情からの変質^00だったが、それにより高い攻撃力を手にした
records.en_original: Type: Reaper <CR>This mutation was once a creature of caution, but its newly magma-imbued cloack gives it incredibly dangerous.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Reaper <CR>This mutation was once a creature of caution, but its magma-imbued cloak makes it incredibly dangerous.
records.en: Type: Reaper^00Its cloak fused with magma, granting it even greater power.^00It originated from wary emotions toward others,^00but the mutation gave it tremendous offensive strength.

records.jp: 種族：死神族^00あらゆる感情エーテルを吸収したことで強い^00力を得た個体。この魔物と敵対した個体は、^00例外なく消されてしまうという
records.en_original: Type: Reaper <CR>A demon that absorbed all types of emotional energy. Any foe that crosses its path will be eliminated.
records.en_auxiliary: Type: Reaper <CR>A monster that absorbed all types of emotional energy. Any foe that crosses its path will be eliminated.
records.en: Type: Reaper^00An individual that gained great power by absorbing every kind of emotional Ether.^00It is said that anything that opposes this monster^00is erased without exception.
